why: A language note that leaves an italic open ('(_In Mandarin_)_:_[...' in 3872, '_(In English):_ We' in 12857) also loses the close mark after the colon, which had become a stray '_' at the start of the transcript. A mark that opens the speech's own italic ('(In Malay):_Salam_', a made-up line) stays.
title: Sample Question
html:
Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio): Mdm Speaker, in Mandarin.

(In Mandarin): [Please refer to Vernacular Speech.] I welcome the move by the Government to raise the income ceiling of the Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) from $1,900 to $2,000.

Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade): How will MUIS provide support to them under this masterplan for asatizahs?

(In English): We need to enhance our asatizahs' functioning capabilities.

Mr Lim: Sir, I will speak in Malay.

(In Malay):Salam sejahtera, Tuan Speaker.
